newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise October rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise October rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Wednesday that it would raise the margin requirement on its October rubber futures contract by 20,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Thursday.
The hike will bring the total October margin requirement to 127,750 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
The increase was intended to cool overheated trade.
The requirement on other rubber futures contracts will be unchanged at 52,500 yen, TOCOM said.
